---

# 0  Download SRU data (run once)

The official SRU inventory is published by the Ministère de la Transition
écologique on data.gouv.fr. The chunk below downloads the **2022 vintage**
(matching your 2021 Census) directly into your project folder. Run it once;
afterwards it just reads the cached file.

```{r download-sru}
if (!file.exists(path_sru_csv)) {
  # Direct CSV link — "Communes et inventaire SRU" (situation au 1er janvier 2022)
  # Source: https://www.data.gouv.fr/datasets/communes-et-inventaire-sru
  sru_url <- "https://www.data.gouv.fr/api/1/datasets/r/6c9e0f6c-dfbe-4c59-bd63-58e4e2c9b5d9"
  download.file(sru_url, destfile = path_sru_csv, mode = "wb")
  message("SRU data downloaded to ", path_sru_csv)
} else {
  message("SRU file already present — skipping download.")
}
```

---

# 1  Load and prepare data

```{r load-data}
# Population / housing shapefile
iris_pop <- st_read(path_pop_shp, quiet = TRUE)

# Rental variables
france_rental <- read_csv(path_rental_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Join and clean (mirrors France_DiverseIndex.Rmd exactly)
iris_df <- iris_pop %>%
  left_join(france_rental, by = c("CODE_IR" = "IRIS")) %>%
  select(-ends_with(".y")) %>%
  rename_with(~ gsub("\\.x$", "", .)) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(P21_PMEN, rental_sh, P21_RP, P21_RPMAISON,
             P21_RPAPPART, P21_LOGVAC, P21_LOG), as.numeric)
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

# Three-way tenure classification
iris_df <- iris_df %>%
  mutate(
    tenure_type = case_when(
      rental_sh <  20 ~ "Rental Desert",
      rental_sh >= 80 ~ "High-Rental",
      TRUE            ~ "Mixed-Tenure"
    ),
    tenure_type = factor(tenure_type,
                         levels = c("Rental Desert", "Mixed-Tenure", "High-Rental"))
  )

# Geographic category from binary flags (city / suburb / rural)
iris_df <- iris_df %>%
  mutate(
    geo_type = case_when(
      city   == 1 ~ "Central city",
      suburb == 1 ~ "Suburb",
      TRUE        ~ "Isolated / outside urban unit"
    )
  )

cat("IRIS loaded:", nrow(iris_df), "\n")
cat("Tenure breakdown:\n")
print(table(iris_df$tenure_type, useNA = "ifany"))
```

---

# 2  TABLE 1 — IRIS characteristics by tenure category

## 2.1  Coverage

```{r t1-coverage}
t1_coverage <- iris_df %>%
  group_by(tenure_type) %>%
  summarise(n_iris = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(share_pct = round(n_iris / sum(n_iris) * 100, 1))

kable(t1_coverage,
      col.names = c("Tenure type", "N IRIS", "Share of all IRIS (%)"),
      caption   = "Table 1a. IRIS counts by tenure category")
```

## 2.2  Housing structure averages

```{r t1-housing}
t1_housing <- iris_df %>%
  group_by(tenure_type) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_rental_sh   = round(mean(rental_sh,                      na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    avg_primary_res = round(mean(P21_RP,                         na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    avg_sh_maison   = round(mean(P21_RPMAISON / P21_RP * 100,    na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    avg_sh_appart   = round(mean(P21_RPAPPART / P21_RP * 100,    na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    avg_sh_vacant   = round(mean(P21_LOGVAC   / P21_LOG  * 100,  na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    .groups         = "drop"
  )

kable(t1_housing,
      col.names = c("Tenure type", "Avg rental share (%)",
                    "Avg primary residences", "Avg single-family (%)",
                    "Avg apartments (%)", "Avg vacancy rate (%)"),
      caption   = "Table 1b. Housing structure averages by tenure category")
```

## 2.3  Geographic distribution

```{r t1-geography}
t1_geo <- iris_df %>%
  group_by(tenure_type, geo_type) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(tenure_type) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = tenure_type, values_from = pct, values_fill = 0)

kable(t1_geo,
      col.names = c("Geographic type",
                    "Rental Desert", "Mixed-Tenure", "High-Rental"),
      caption   = "Table 1c. Geographic distribution by tenure category (%)")
```

---

# 3  TABLE 2 — Spatial distribution across the 100 largest urban units

## 3.1  Top 100 UUs by population

```{r uu-top100}
top_100_uu <- iris_df %>%
  group_by(UU2020) %>%
  summarise(total_pop = sum(P21_PMEN, na.rm = TRUE),
            lib2020   = first(lib2020), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!str_detect(lib2020, "^Commune hors")) %>%   # ← add this
  arrange(desc(total_pop)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 100)
```

## 3.2  Metro-level stats: rental share, rental desert share, divergence

```{r uu-stats}
iris_top100 <- iris_df %>% filter(UU2020 %in% top_100_uu$UU2020)

metro_shares <- iris_top100 %>%
  group_by(UU2020) %>%
  summarise(metro_rental_sh = mean(rental_sh, na.rm = TRUE),
            metro_owner_sh  = 100 - metro_rental_sh,
            .groups         = "drop")

# IRIS divergence (same formula as France_DiverseIndex.Rmd)
iris_diverg <- iris_top100 %>%
  left_join(metro_shares, by = "UU2020") %>%
  mutate(
    owner_sh       = 100 - rental_sh,
    divergence_val = rental_sh * log(rental_sh / metro_rental_sh) +
                     owner_sh  * log(owner_sh  / metro_owner_sh)
  )

# UU-level: population-weighted divergence + rental desert share
uu_stats <- iris_diverg %>%
  group_by(UU2020) %>%
  summarise(
    lib2020         = first(lib2020),
    total_pop       = sum(P21_PMEN, na.rm = TRUE),
    metro_rental_sh = round(first(metro_rental_sh), 1),
    rd_share_pct    = round(mean(rental_sh < 20, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1),
    avg_divergence  = round(
      weighted.mean(divergence_val, w = P21_PMEN, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(total_pop_000 = round(total_pop / 1000, 0))
```

## 3.3  Top 10 most divergent + bottom 10 least divergent

```{r t2-top-bottom}
top10    <- uu_stats %>% arrange(desc(avg_divergence)) %>% slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  mutate(group = "Top 10 (most divergent)")
bottom10 <- uu_stats %>% arrange(avg_divergence)      %>% slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  mutate(group = "Bottom 10 (least divergent)")

t2_table <- bind_rows(top10, bottom10) %>%
  select(group, lib2020, total_pop_000, rd_share_pct,
         metro_rental_sh, avg_divergence)

kable(t2_table,
      col.names = c("Group", "Urban Unit", "Population (000s)",
                    "Rental Desert Share (%)", "Metro Rental Share (%)",
                    "Divergence Index"),
      caption   = "Table 2. Rental desert geography across urban units") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) %>%
  pack_rows("Top 10 — Most Segregated by Housing Tenure",    1,  10) %>%
  pack_rows("Bottom 10 — Least Segregated by Housing Tenure", 11, 20)
```

## 3.4  Cross-check against Paris (should be ≈ 7.91 from DiverseIndex.html)

```{r t2-paris-check}
paris <- uu_stats %>% filter(UU2020 == "00851")
cat("Paris divergence (this script):", paris$avg_divergence, "\n")
cat("Paris divergence (DiverseIndex.html):", 7.91, "\n")
cat("Note: small difference is expected — DiverseIndex.Rmd uses unweighted mean;\n",
    "      this script uses population-weighted mean.\n")
```

---

# 4  TABLE 3 — Correlations

## 4.1  Income divergence (mirrors France_DiverseIndex.Rmd)

```{r income-divergence}
income_raw <- read_csv(path_income_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)

income_df <- income_raw %>%
  filter(UU2020 %in% top_100_uu$UU2020) %>%
  mutate(
    income_cat = case_when(
      DEC_MED21 <  20000 ~ "Lower",
      DEC_MED21 <  40000 ~ "Middle",
      !is.na(DEC_MED21)  ~ "Higher",
      TRUE               ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(income_cat))

income_shares <- income_df %>%
  group_by(UU2020, income_cat) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(UU2020) %>%
  mutate(iris_share = count / sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup()

metro_income <- income_shares %>%
  group_by(income_cat) %>%
  summarise(metro_share = mean(iris_share, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

income_divergence <- income_shares %>%
  left_join(metro_income, by = "income_cat") %>%
  mutate(component = iris_share * log(iris_share / metro_share)) %>%
  group_by(UU2020) %>%
  summarise(income_div_idx = sum(component, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

## 4.2  Building age entropy (mirrors France_DiverseIndex.Rmd)

```{r building-age}
bldg_age_uu <- iris_df %>%
  filter(UU2020 %in% top_100_uu$UU2020) %>%
  mutate(across(c(P21_RP_ACH19, P21_RP_ACH45, P21_RP_ACH70,
                  P21_RP_ACH90, P21_RP_ACH05, P21_RP_ACH18,
                  P21_RP_ACHTOT), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(
    s19 = P21_RP_ACH19 / P21_RP_ACHTOT,
    s45 = P21_RP_ACH45 / P21_RP_ACHTOT,
    s70 = P21_RP_ACH70 / P21_RP_ACHTOT,
    s90 = P21_RP_ACH90 / P21_RP_ACHTOT,
    s05 = P21_RP_ACH05 / P21_RP_ACHTOT,
    s18 = P21_RP_ACH18 / P21_RP_ACHTOT
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    bldg_entropy = -sum(
      c(s19, s45, s70, s90, s05, s18) *
      log(c(s19, s45, s70, s90, s05, s18)),
      na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(UU2020) %>%
  summarise(bldg_age_div_idx = mean(bldg_entropy, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

## 4.3  Correlations

```{r t3-correlations}
corr_data <- uu_stats %>%
  select(UU2020, avg_divergence) %>%
  left_join(income_divergence, by = "UU2020") %>%
  left_join(bldg_age_uu,       by = "UU2020") %>%
  filter(!is.na(avg_divergence),
         !is.na(income_div_idx),
         !is.na(bldg_age_div_idx))

cat("N urban units for correlations:", nrow(corr_data), "\n\n")

cor1 <- cor.test(corr_data$avg_divergence, corr_data$income_div_idx,  method = "pearson")
cor2 <- cor.test(corr_data$avg_divergence, corr_data$bldg_age_div_idx, method = "pearson")

cat("Housing Tenure × Income divergence:\n")
cat("  r =", round(cor1$estimate, 3), " p =", format.pval(cor1$p.value, digits = 3), "\n\n")
cat("Housing Tenure × Building age entropy:\n")
cat("  r =", round(cor2$estimate, 3), " p =", format.pval(cor2$p.value, digits = 3), "\n")
```

```{r t3-table}
t3 <- tibble(
  Pairing = c("Tenure divergence × Income divergence",
              "Tenure divergence × Building age entropy"),
  r       = round(c(cor1$estimate, cor2$estimate), 3),
  CI      = c(
    paste0("[", round(cor1$conf.int[1],3), ", ", round(cor1$conf.int[2],3), "]"),
    paste0("[", round(cor2$conf.int[1],3), ", ", round(cor2$conf.int[2],3), "]")
  ),
  N       = c(cor1$parameter + 2, cor2$parameter + 2),
  p       = c(format.pval(cor1$p.value, digits = 2),
              format.pval(cor2$p.value, digits = 2))
)

kable(t3,
      col.names = c("Pairing", "Pearson r", "95% CI", "N", "p-value"),
      caption   = "Table 3. Correlations: housing tenure divergence × socioeconomic measures") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```

# 5  TABLE 4 — SRU compliance and rental share (OLS)

## 5.1  Load and inspect SRU data

```{r load-sru}
# The CSV uses semicolons as delimiter and Latin-1 encoding (typical for French gov files)
sru_raw <- read_delim(path_sru_csv, delim = ";", locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"),
                      show_col_types = FALSE)

# Inspect what we have
cat("Rows:", nrow(sru_raw), "  Cols:", ncol(sru_raw), "\n")
cat("Column names:\n")
print(names(sru_raw))
```

## 5.2  Clean SRU and join to commune-level rental share

```{r sru-prep}
library(readxl)
library(janitor)

path_sru_csv <- paste0(base_path, "sru_inventory_2022.csv")

if (!file.exists(path_sru_csv)) {
  download.file(
    "https://www.data.gouv.fr/api/1/datasets/r/adbd736b-b24f-495e-8a9f-70689c44446c",
    destfile = path_sru_csv, mode = "wb"
  )
}

# Row 1 is blank, row 2 is headers → skip = 1
sru_raw <- read_csv(
  path_sru_csv,
  skip   = 1,
  locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  clean_names()   # snake_case, strips accents from é/è etc.

# Parse rate columns: "52,95 %" → 52.95
parse_pct <- function(x) {
  as.numeric(str_replace_all(x, "[^0-9,]", "") %>% str_replace(",", "."))
}

sru <- sru_raw %>%
  transmute(
    codgeo        = str_pad(as.character(code_insee_commune), 5, "left", "0"),
    taux_lls      = parse_pct(taux_sru_au_01_01_2023),
    objectif_lls  = parse_pct(taux_cible_commune_2023_2025),
    # commune_deficitaire_2024 == 0 means the commune meets its target
    sru_compliant = if_else(commune_deficitaire_2024 == 0, 1L, 0L,
                            missing = NA_integer_)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(codgeo), !is.na(taux_lls))

cat("SRU communes after cleaning:", nrow(sru), "\n")
cat("Compliant:",     sum(sru$sru_compliant == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Non-compliant:", sum(sru$sru_compliant == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
print(head(sru))
```

## 5.3  Commune-level rental share (from IRIS data)

```{r commune-rental}
# codgeo in your IRIS data is the 5-digit commune code
commune_rental <- iris_df %>%
  mutate(codgeo = str_pad(as.character(codgeo), 5, "left", "0")) %>%
  group_by(codgeo) %>%
  summarise(
    commune_rental_sh = mean(rental_sh,            na.rm = TRUE),
    n_iris            = n(),
    geo_type          = first(geo_type),
    UU2020            = first(UU2020),
    .groups           = "drop"
  )

# Join SRU onto commune rental data
policy_df <- commune_rental %>%
  left_join(sru, by = "codgeo") %>%
  filter(!is.na(taux_lls))     # keep only SRU-covered communes

cat("Communes with SRU data:", nrow(policy_df), "\n")
```

## 5.4  OLS regressions

```{r}
sru_raw <- read_csv(
  path_sru_csv,
  skip          = 1,           # row 1 is blank/title; row 2 is the real header
  locale        = locale(encoding = "latin1"),
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  col_select     = -1          # drop the empty leading column
)

parse_pct <- function(x) {
  as.numeric(str_replace_all(x, c("," = ".", "\\s*%" = "", "\\s" = "")))
}

sru <- sru_raw %>%
  rename(
    codgeo      = Code_INSEE_commune,
    taux_lls    = Taux_SRU_au_01_01_2023,
    taux_cible  = Taux_cible_commune_2023_2025,
    deficitaire = `Commune_déficitaire_2024`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    codgeo        = str_pad(as.character(codgeo), 5, "left", "0"),
    taux_lls      = parse_pct(taux_lls),
    taux_cible    = parse_pct(taux_cible),
    sru_compliant = as.integer(deficitaire == 0)
  ) %>%
  select(codgeo, taux_lls, taux_cible, sru_compliant)

cat("SRU communes:", nrow(sru), "\n")
cat("Compliant:", sum(sru$sru_compliant, na.rm = TRUE),
    " | Non-compliant:", sum(sru$sru_compliant == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```


```{r t4-regressions}
library(broom)

# Model 1: SRU compliance (binary: meets target or not)
lm1 <- lm(commune_rental_sh ~ sru_compliant, data = policy_df)

# Model 2: Actual LLS rate (continuous — how much social housing already exists)
lm2 <- lm(commune_rental_sh ~ taux_lls, data = policy_df)

# Model 3: Both together
lm3 <- lm(commune_rental_sh ~ sru_compliant + taux_lls, data = policy_df)

# Model 4: By geography (central city vs suburb)
lm4 <- lm(commune_rental_sh ~ sru_compliant * geo_type, data = policy_df)

cat("── Model 1: SRU compliance (binary) ──────────────────────────────\n")
print(summary(lm1))

cat("\n── Model 2: Actual LLS rate ──────────────────────────────────────\n")
print(summary(lm2))

cat("\n── Model 3: Both ─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
print(summary(lm3))

cat("\n── Model 4: Compliance × Geography ──────────────────────────────\n")
print(summary(lm4))
```

## 5.5  Table 4 formatted output

```{r t4-table}
coef_table <- bind_rows(
  tidy(lm1, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(model = "M1: SRU compliance"),
  tidy(lm2, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(model = "M2: LLS rate"),
  tidy(lm3, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(model = "M3: Both")
) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high), ~ round(., 2)),
    p.value  = format.pval(p.value, digits = 2),
    stars    = case_when(
      as.numeric(p.value) < 0.001 ~ "***",
      as.numeric(p.value) < 0.01  ~ "**",
      as.numeric(p.value) < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE                        ~ ""
    )
  ) %>%
  select(model, term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value, stars)

kable(coef_table,
      col.names = c("Model", "Variable", "β (pp)", "CI low", "CI high",
                    "p-value", ""),
      caption   = "Table 4. SRU policy indicators and commune-level rental share (OLS)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover"))
```

8. DIAGNOSTIC: income file coverage
```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
income_raw <- read_csv(path_income_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)

cat("Total rows in income file:", nrow(income_raw), "\n")
cat("Columns:\n"); print(names(income_raw))

cat("\nUnique UU2020 codes in income file:",
    n_distinct(income_raw$UU2020), "\n")

cat("Top-100 UUs with ANY income data:",
    sum(top_100_uu$UU2020 %in% income_raw$UU2020), "\n")

income_raw %>%
  filter(UU2020 %in% top_100_uu$UU2020) %>%
  group_by(UU2020) %>%
  summarise(
    n_iris        = n(),
    n_with_income = sum(!is.na(DEC_MED21)),
    pct_coverage  = round(n_with_income / n_iris * 100, 1),
    .groups       = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(pct_coverage) %>%
  print(n = 20)
```
```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# ── Step 0: check coverage for your actual top-100 UUs ───────────────────────
income_full <- read_csv(
  paste0(base_path, "Updated_France_Rental_with_Income.csv"),
  locale         = locale(encoding = "latin1"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  rename(CODE_IR = IRIS) %>%
  mutate(
    UU2020    = as.character(UU2020),
    DEC_MED21 = as.numeric(DEC_MED21)
  )

# Coverage per UU among your top-100
coverage_check <- income_full %>%
  filter(UU2020 %in% top_100_uu$UU2020) %>%
  group_by(UU2020) %>%
  summarise(
    lib2020       = first(na.omit(top_100_uu$lib2020[top_100_uu$UU2020 == cur_group()$UU2020])),
    n_iris_total  = n(),
    n_with_income = sum(!is.na(DEC_MED21)),
    pct_coverage  = round(n_with_income / n_iris_total * 100, 1),
    .groups       = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(pct_coverage)

cat("UUs in top-100 with income coverage:\n")
cat("  Full (100%)   :", sum(coverage_check$pct_coverage == 100), "\n")
cat("  Partial (>0%) :", sum(coverage_check$pct_coverage > 0 &
                             coverage_check$pct_coverage < 100), "\n")
cat("  None (0%)     :", sum(coverage_check$pct_coverage == 0), "\n\n")

# Show UUs with 0% coverage — these drive the N limitation
cat("UUs with NO income data:\n")
print(coverage_check %>% filter(pct_coverage == 0) %>%
      left_join(top_100_uu %>% select(UU2020, lib2020), by = "UU2020") %>%
      select(UU2020, lib2020.y, n_iris_total))
```

```{r}
# ── Step 1: income divergence using all available IRIS ───────────────────────
income_top100 <- income_full %>%
  filter(
    UU2020 %in% top_100_uu$UU2020,
    !is.na(DEC_MED21)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    income_cat = case_when(
      DEC_MED21 <  20000 ~ "Lower",
      DEC_MED21 <  40000 ~ "Middle",
      TRUE               ~ "Higher"
    )
  )

cat("IRIS with income data across top-100 UUs:", nrow(income_top100), "\n")
cat("UUs represented:", n_distinct(income_top100$UU2020), "\n\n")

# IRIS share of each income category within each UU
income_shares <- income_top100 %>%
  group_by(UU2020, income_cat) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(UU2020) %>%
  mutate(iris_share = count / sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Reference: average distribution across all UUs with data
metro_income_ref <- income_shares %>%
  group_by(income_cat) %>%
  summarise(metro_share = mean(iris_share, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Income divergence index per UU
income_divergence <- income_shares %>%
  left_join(metro_income_ref, by = "income_cat") %>%
  mutate(component = iris_share * log(iris_share / metro_share)) %>%
  group_by(UU2020) %>%
  summarise(
    income_div_idx = sum(component, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_iris_income  = sum(count),
    .groups        = "drop"
  )

cat("Income divergence computed for", nrow(income_divergence), "urban units\n")
```
```{r}
# ── Step 2: correlations ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
corr_data <- uu_stats %>%
  select(UU2020, avg_divergence) %>%
  left_join(income_divergence, by = "UU2020") %>%
  left_join(bldg_age_uu,       by = "UU2020") %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(avg_divergence),
    !is.na(income_div_idx),
    !is.na(bldg_age_div_idx)
  )

cat("N for income correlation    :", 
    sum(!is.na(corr_data$income_div_idx)), "\n")
cat("N for building age correlation:",
    sum(!is.na(corr_data$bldg_age_div_idx)), "\n\n")

cor1 <- cor.test(corr_data$avg_divergence, corr_data$income_div_idx,
                 method = "pearson")
cor2 <- cor.test(corr_data$avg_divergence, corr_data$bldg_age_div_idx,
                 method = "pearson")

cat("Housing Tenure × Income divergence:\n")
cat("  r =", round(cor1$estimate, 3),
    " 95% CI: [", round(cor1$conf.int[1], 3), ",",
                  round(cor1$conf.int[2], 3), "]",
    " p =", format.pval(cor1$p.value, digits = 3), "\n\n")

cat("Housing Tenure × Building age entropy:\n")
cat("  r =", round(cor2$estimate, 3),
    " 95% CI: [", round(cor2$conf.int[1], 3), ",",
                  round(cor2$conf.int[2], 3), "]",
    " p =", format.pval(cor2$p.value, digits = 3), "\n")
```
